author: kk428
body: I implemented some small changes that improve the efficiency for high pT (2 TeV) QCD. - If a pT5 has a poor score (> 200), and if its pLS has pT > 5 GeV, it is demoted and only its T5 becomes a TC - In T4 cross-cleaning, account for the T5s that once were part of pT5s - After pT5 cleaning, parts of dead pT5s are freed to potentially form pT3s More details explaining these changes are provided in my [slides](https://indico.cern.ch/event/1713157/contributions/7206144/attachments/3355169/6016962/10-2-26%20Efficiency%20Update%20(1).pdf) from 10/2/26. I made these changes with the assistance of Claude. In the plots below, the effects of this PR (red) are compared to the CMSSW_20_1_X_2026-11-04-1100 IB (black). The HLT plots for the QCD and ttbar samples for 1000 events are available [here](https://www.classe.cornell.edu/~kk829/hlt-plots/). The standard set of LST mtv plots for 1000 QCD events and 175 ttbar events are available [here](https://www.classe.cornell.edu/~kk829/mtv-plots/). The ttbar HLT efficiency might appear to be affected, but this is the result of a handful of tracks. We have decided that these fluctuations in the efficiency are acceptable. This is clearer in the 5000 event HLT ttbar plots [here](https://www.classe.cornell.edu/~kk829/ttbar-PRgate-5000/plots_hlt.html), and explained in more detail in [these slides](https://indico.cern.ch/event/1713163/contributions/7206246/attachments/3381447/6072534/26.11.13%20Fixed%20the%20ttbar%20efficiency%20in%20PR286.pdf) from 11/13/26. 1000 event HLT ttbar sample:
title: LST: Demote poor-score high-pT pT5s to T5 track candidates and improve efficiency
